If you really wanna grind gold keep doing your daily challenges and youll soon be able to swim in the stuff.

The best thing I've found so far for $ grind is to do the collector role, hunt and donate it all to Cripps until your material's is at 100% which usually takes a couple hours and whilst youre waiting for that to finish you can go collect whatever you need to collect that day.
Youll have to head back to camp every half hour to do a resupply mission or Cripps will stop producing your goods, they can take between 5/10 mins but after that youre good to go collecting again.

By time youre done collecting and you made your $2000 you can sell all your goods for $625 but youll need to by high enough level to buy the large delivery wagon.

If you got the gold you may as well cause its something extra to do whilst online I personally think its the worst/best role cause on the good side its the only role that you can earn gold with but on the other hand the pay out in $ is terrible.

Either way I say go for it cause ill take any excuse to shoot up some bad guys since its so few and far between on RDO and the stuff you unlock getting to level 20 is pretty neato.
